# The boards

Each board is one task release: its circuit, its physics (fixed blocks), the checks an entry must pass, its rule set and its ranking metric. The newest release of each task, in the website's order. A board is named by its title, its task, or `<task>@<release>`.

## Required checks

Every required check must come back `passed` under the reference profile; skipped, unsupported, partial, timed out or cancelled is never eligible.

- `bundle`, `device`, `physics_lock`, `program`, `rules`, `certificate_binding`, `lean_certificate`, `semantics`, `correspondence`, `metrics`: 6 boards (`bb144@1`, `rep9@1`, `five_qubit@1`, `steane@1`, `surface17@1`, `ghz4@1`)
- `bundle`, `device`, `physics_lock`, `program`, `rules`, `certificate_binding`, `lean_certificate`, `semantics`, `correspondence`, `metrics`, `ler`: 24 boards (`rep5_mem@1`, `surface3_mem@1`, `surface5xz_mem@1`, `surface3xz_mem@1`, `surface7xz_mem@1`, `steanexz_mem@1`, `shorxz_mem@1`, `rep3xz_mem@1`, `rep5xz_mem@1`, `bb18xz_mem@1`, `bb72seq_mem@1`, `bb90seq_mem@1`, `goal3_surface3_mem@1`, `goal3_surface5_mem@1`, `goal3_surface7_mem@1`, `goal3_color3_mem@1`, `goal3_color5_mem@1`, `goal3_color7_mem@1`, `goal3_bb72_mem@1`, `goal3_hgp58_mem@1`, `c2lr_rep5_mem_basr@1`, `c2lr_rep5_mem_ybba@1`, `c2lr_surface3_mem_basr@1`, `c2lr_surface3_mem_ybba@1`)

Allowed transformations between the certified and the final program: `insert:cool`.
